title: The density of an integer multiplicity measure equals its multiplicity H^n-almost everywhere
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P and every integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n (carrier M, multiplicity θ : ℝ^P → ℕ, orientation ξ), if the measure μ_R := R.measure = θ·μHE[n]⌞M satisfies μ_R(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, then for μHE[n]-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P the ratio μ_R(B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) (open balls, ω_n = unitBallVolume n, computed in [0, ∞]) tends to 1_M(x)·θ(x) as ρ ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 1 ≤ n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Set.indicator R.carrier (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x))
